name: Frost Spree assaults nearby enemies instead of doing nothing
contract: Frost Spree 913453 is built entirely from native no-op effects without a script: Effect[0] is
SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DUMMY (amplitude 500ms over a 2000ms duration, 4 ticks), Effect[1] is SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY
on the explicit cast target, and Effect[2] (SPELL_AURA_ALLOW_ONLY_ABILITY) is native but has no visible
effect by itself. With no script, casting it only applies the invisible restriction aura - matching the
report's 'cooldown triggers, nothing else happens'. This mirrors the native vanilla Killing Spree pattern
('This uses Killing Spree modifiers.'). The fix registers an equivalent SpellScript+AuraScript pair that
teleports the caster to a random nearby enemy and casts Frost Blitz (913454, already-native normalized
weapon damage that natively triggers its own off-hand half 913455) on cast and on each of the 4 periodic
ticks, for up to 5 total assaults, matching the tooltip exactly. The native vanilla Killing Spree's own
cast-time FilterTargets refuses the cast outright (FinishCast) when the caster is rooted or vehicle-bound
(src/server/scripts/Spells/spell_rogue.cpp), so the equivalent guard belongs here too: FrostSpreeAssault
skips the teleport and the weapon-damage cast whenever the caster is dead, vehicle-bound, rooted or stunned,
re-checked on every assault since this script re-queries a live nearby target instead of a pre-collected list.

steps.label: Cast Frost Spree again while rooted
A rooted caster is never teleported to the target
A rooted caster lands no Frost Blitz assaults
